from flask import Flask, request, jsonify, render_template_string import sqlite3 import os import bleach import re app = Flask(__name__) DB_PATH = os.environ.get('DB_PATH', '/tmp/comments.db') def init_db(): conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH) c = conn.cursor() c.execute('''CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS comments (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, username TEXT NOT NULL, comment TEXT NOT NULL, category TEXT DEFAULT 'general')''') conn.commit() conn.close() def sanitize_username(username): # Only allow alphanumeric and basic punctuation return re.sub(r'[^a-zA-Z0-9_\-\. ]', '', username) @app.route('/api/comments', methods=['POST']) def add_comment(): data = request.get_json() if not data: return jsonify({'error': 'Invalid JSON'}), 400 username = data.get('username', 'anonymous') comment = data.get('comment', '') category = data.get('category', 'general') # Sanitize username strictly username = sanitize_username(username) # Comment sanitization - allow some HTML for formatting # Note: bleach.clean with allowed tags allowed_tags = ['b', 'i', 'u', 'em', 'strong', 'a'] allowed_attrs = {'a': ['href', 'title']} comment = bleach.clean(comment, tags=allowed_tags, attributes=allowed_attrs) # Category is used for CSS class assignment - environment.description: Same Flask container (comment-service:14) deployed in ECS Fargate but fronted by Amazon API Gateway (REST API, regional endpoint). The POST /api/comments method has a request validator attached (validateRequestBody: true) with a JSON Schema model 'CommentModel' that enforces: 'category' field must match enum ['general', 'bug', 'feature', 'question'] with pattern '^[a-z]+$' and maxLength 10; 'comment' field has maxLength 2000 and type string; 'username' has pattern '^[a-zA-Z0-9_\-\.\s]{1,50}$'. The integration type is VPC_LINK to the internal NLB. Gateway responses for 4xx include CORS headers. The API stage has a usage plan with throttling (100 req/s burst, 50 req/s steady). CloudWatch logging enabled at INFO level on the stage. Note: the request validator operates at the gateway layer before traffic reaches the container, rejecting non-conforming payloads with 400 status.

config.infrastructure: AWS ECS Fargate + API Gateway (REST) + internal NLB via VPC Link
config.vpc_link: internal NLB (no public access to container)
config.security_group: SG allows inbound only from VPC CIDR on port 8080
